blurb: A pin on `Val[T]` is checked against the refinement of `T` when the program compiles, so it must be a literal of `T`'s base type. A name or a call has no value at that point. Write the literal in place. For a computed value, build it with `Age.of(…)` and `?`, which fails the case if the value is not valid.
summary: A `Val[T]` pin argument is not a compile-time literal.
